sound_sync_notes: walk foot contacts are at local [18, 26, 34, 42] (film [234, 242, 250, 258]); U1's footstep cues (film 240/252/264/276) assumed 12-frame steps -- the editor should move the 4 footsteps to these contact frames. Box tick into her fingertips at local 126 (film 342, U1 cue 341). Lid shut hidden at local 190-197 (U1 cue 408 falls inside). Set-down on lap at local 240 (film 456 = U1 cue).
angle_convention: degrees, clockwise positive in y-down screen coords, relative to parent piece; rest = hanging down. R. faces left (positive shoulder = arm forward); the aunt faces right (negative shoulder = arm forward).

ring.note: spec ring outer_d 0.11w enlarged to 0.27w so it reads in silhouette; punched light annulus + stone standing in the slot, lower part hidden behind the front wall; bloom = light through the hole

box.lid_open_drawing: lid inner face rises behind the body, height depth*sin(angle) + lid_h*max(0.25,cos)

evidence_foraged.title: Jim Tillman and his girl in the lounge of the student union. University of Nebraska, Lincoln (May 1942)
evidence_foraged.author: John Vachon, U.S. Farm Security Administration / Office of War Information
evidence_foraged.license: Public domain (US government work); LoC rights_information: 'No known restrictions on publication'
evidence_foraged.what_it_shows: lounge interior, couple on a striped sofa; at upper right the venetian window blinds (crop x 862-985, y 40-440 of the 1024 px scan, avoiding the film-edge 'EASTMAN SAFETY' lettering)
evidence_foraged.verified_date_or_place: May 1942, University of Nebraska student union, Lincoln (LoC item record it-2017831564.json, rights fields re-read 2026-11-16)
evidence_foraged.used_as: S2 far plane: blinds thresholded at the 45th percentile, Gaussian-softened (sigma 3 px), edge-feathered, cast as a faint shadow (max 15 % darkening) behind the paper screen, travelling 0.3x the set

handmade.what: R. jointed card puppet: quiff profile head, jacket with lapel notch (profile) + 3/4-turned replacement torso, shoulder/elbow/wrist (near and far arms), hip/knee/ankle (both legs), pin-rivet pinholes; far arm bent behind his back

Aunt jointed card puppet: chignon (two buns), two replacement head profiles (up / looking down, lips parted), drop earring on a simulated damped pendulum, shoulder/elbow/wrist arm with open palm and separated thumb, skirt as one piece, shins

Wing chair with punched lace antimacassar (3 rows of holes + scalloped edge), standard lamp with punched light slot, door frame + door in 3 drawings with punched mouldings, scalloped floor rail with punched holes (foreground, 1.3x travel)

Backlit paper screen: hot-spot backlight falloff, low-frequency mottling and 2,600 random curved fibre strokes, warmed +5 % (R x1.05, B x0.95); paper L p5 177-179 / p50 200-202 / p95 212, chroma ~20, ink #1c1713

Silver box silhouette in front elevation from box-spec.json (w, body 0.30w, lid 0.08w, depth 0.62w, lid drawings 0/35/70/105 deg), ball feet, lid seam / velvet-lip punched lines; ring as punched light annulus + stone standing in the slot at cx 0.50 with bloom
label « — selon lui — » Liberation Serif Italic 18 px, 80 % opacity, dark sepia, top centre on every S2 frame

absences: No new downloads were needed or made: the only foraged layer (blinds) reuses the already-verified LoC 2017831564 scan on disk.
Not searched: Moving Image Archive footage -- the flashback is wholly handmade shadow theatre by design (plan section 7); no archive clip was required for U3.
No sound produced by U3 (U1 owns the flashback bed); see sound_sync_notes for frame-accurate event times.
deviations: Box shown at 72 px (about 1/5 of R.'s height) and the ring at 0.27w instead of 0.11w: theatrical prop scale so the ring reads in silhouette (test-shot note: 'legible ring'). Slot/ring position cx 0.50 kept from box-spec.
Walk is 2 cycles x 8 poses on twos (4 steps, contacts every 8 frames), not the 12-frame steps assumed by U1's footstep cues; editor should re-time footsteps to walk_foot_contacts.
Swallow approach and swallow (local 184-199) are on ones for the quick pull-in; everything else on twos.

Ring/slot match: on-screen x of the ring (370.0) equals the present insert's slot x (370.0); y differs (252 vs 304) because the insert is a closer framing. Normalised in-box x 0.500 vs 0.484 (diff 0.016 < 0.05).
